client: I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately with the pressure to achieve top grades in my final semester of college. Every time I hear my classmates discussing their intense study plans, it just heightens my anxiety and makes me feel like I'm falling behind. I can't shake this feeling that I might not be good enough, and I'm starting to wonder if therapy can really help me with this.
therapist: It sounds like you're carrying a heavy weight right now, feeling the pressure to keep up with your classmates and questioning your own abilities. The heightened anxiety you're experiencing is completely understandable, especially in such a competitive environment. It's important to recognize these feelings and know that therapy can be a supportive space to explore them further and develop strategies to manage the stress you're facing. You're not alone in this, and we can work together to find ways to feel more confident and grounded.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, moderate volume, moderate-paced speech
